reduction: n linear and k linear in log k in wavelength between the source's rows, onto 380–780 nm every 5 nm, to six significant figures, n from the rows that give n (every 20 nm over 210–500 nm, then 1,000 nm) and k from the rows that give k (every 20 nm from 400 nm). The source gives no k below 400 nm, so over 380–400 nm k is extrapolated linearly in log k from its 400 and 420 nm rows (7.9 × 10⁻⁴ and 6.4 × 10⁻⁴), since the glass absorbs more towards the ultraviolet.
